trigger: SIGTERM sent by timeout to own GStreamer preview after 180 seconds
fault: DMA Write NO_PASID, device 03:00.0, PTE Write access is not set
source_finding: wait_event_interruptible_timeout treats pending exit signal as timeout and stop_streaming then releases queued DMA buffers before firmware acknowledges stop
first_patch_attempt: Replacing the wait alone delayed commands to their timeout limit because IRQ paths still used wake_up_interruptible. This temporary module was not installed into DKMS.
final_patch_scope: bounded non-interruptible firmware completion wait plus matching wake_up_all in all channel IRQ wakeups
